core_obligations: Trivialise the sheaf at the point (proof lines 19245-19250): for a geometric point x of X, local constancy of F makes its restriction to Spec(O^sh_{X,x}) isomorphic to the constant sheaf underline M with M = F_x.

Write M as a filtered colimit of finite groups (proof lines 19251-19254): by the order assumption, M is a filtered colimit of finite abelian groups M_i of order prime to the characteristic of the residue field of x, and each M_i is a finite direct sum of Z/n_{i,j}Z with n_{i,j} prime to that characteristic.

Compute the cohomology (proof lines 19255-19280): for a geometric point t of Spec(O^sh_{S,f(x)}), the fibre F_{x,t} is affine, so the colimit lemma gives H^q(F_{x,t}, underline M) = colim_i H^q(F_{x,t}, underline M_i); local acyclicity of f makes H^q(F_{x,t}, underline{Z/n_{i,j}Z}) equal to Z/n_{i,j}Z for q = 0 and 0 otherwise, and both the direct sum and the colimit preserve this, so H^q(F_{x,t}, underline M) is M for q = 0 and vanishes for q not 0.
Conclude local acyclicity relative to F (proof lines 19281-19286): the displayed vanishing is precisely the definition of local acyclicity of f relative to F.
proof_roadmap: Trivialise the locally constant sheaf at a geometric point and write its stalk as a filtered colimit of finite groups of prime-to-characteristic order.
Use the colimit lemma and local acyclicity of f on the constant sheaves Z/nZ to compute the cohomology of the affine Milnor fibres.
Read off the defining vanishing for local acyclicity relative to F.
difficulty_reason: The lemma promotes plain local acyclicity to local acyclicity relative to any locally constant sheaf whose stalks are torsion groups of order prime to the residue characteristics (statement lines 19233-19242). The proof (proof lines 19244-19286) trivialises the sheaf at a geometric point, writes its stalk as a filtered colimit of finite prime-to-characteristic groups and of the corresponding Z/nZ summands, and computes the cohomology of the affine Milnor fibres by the colimit lemma on top of the vanishing supplied by local acyclicity. H2: one trivialisation and one colimit computation, written out.
